extra_quotes: HPHT diamond crystals were synthesized at 6.5 –7.0 GPa using a cubic press and temperature gradient method .
Polycrystalline diamond films were grown by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) on silicon substrate using an ASTeX PDS -17 microwave plasma reactor at the Institute for Materials Research in Belgium.
Crystalline quality of diamonds was assessed by Raman spectroscopy using a WITec alpha 300R confocal microscopy setup equipped with 633 nm (HeNe), 355 and 532 nm (Nd:YAG) lasers.
Concentrations of nitrogen and boron were measured by Fourier -transform infrared (FTIR) absorption with a Vertex70v spectrometer from Bruker .
Time-resolved luminescence was excited with a nitrogen laser, which provided 3 ns 0.3 mJ pulses at 3.68 eV (337 nm), and detected with a photomultiplier on a Tektronix oscilloscope.
Detection limits were approximately 0.1, 1000, and 0.1 ppm for FTIR, EDS and SIMS, respectively.
